plots.title: Motor voltage (V): command and after the loop delay

parameters.name: L1
parameters.description: Link 1 length, joint-1 axis to joint-2 axis

parameters.name: L2
parameters.description: Link 2 length, joint-2 axis to the tip (where the push acts)

parameters.name: m_tube1
parameters.description: Aluminium tube 20 x 2 mm of link 1 (0.305 kg/m)

parameters.name: m_tube2
parameters.description: Aluminium tube 20 x 2 mm of link 2

parameters.name: tube_od
parameters.description: Outer diameter of the tubes (for the tube inertia)

parameters.name: tube_wall
parameters.description: Wall thickness of the tubes

parameters.name: com_shift1
parameters.description: Shift of the tube's own centre of mass towards the tip, as a fraction of the link length (wall-thickness variation, glue, plugs)

parameters.name: com_shift2
parameters.description: Shift of the tube's own centre of mass towards the tip, as a fraction of the link length

parameters.name: m_hub1
parameters.description: Clamp hub of link 1 at joint 1 (8 mm shaft stub, clamp, screws, magnet holder), at the pivot

parameters.name: m_head1
parameters.description: Head of link 1 at its tip: the joint-2 bearing block with two 688 bearings, the tube clamp and screws (the encoder board is m_enc_board)

parameters.name: m_hub2
parameters.description: Clamp hub of link 2 at joint 2 (8 mm steel shaft in the joint-2 bearings, clamp, magnet holder), at the pivot

parameters.name: m_tip2
parameters.description: Tip cap of link 2 (end plug with a rubber bumper), at the tip

parameters.name: s_hub
parameters.description: Size of a hub for its own inertia (a cube, J = m s^2 / 6)

parameters.name: s_head
parameters.description: Size of link 1's head for its own inertia (a cube)

parameters.name: s_tip
parameters.description: Size of link 2's tip cap for its own inertia (a cube)

parameters.name: m_enc_board
parameters.description: Encoder board with connector and screws; the joint-2 board sits on link 1's head (the joint-1 board is part of m_cart)

parameters.name: m_enc_magnet
parameters.description: Diametric magnet and holder, on each link's hub at the pivot

parameters.name: rho_cable
parameters.description: Mass per length of the joint-2 encoder cable (6-wire SPI) along link 1

parameters.name: m_cart
parameters.description: Cart: carriage, belt clamp, joint-1 bearing block, joint-1 encoder board, share of the cable chain

parameters.name: J_cart
parameters.description: Cart inertia about its centre of mass (bond graph only: the rail holds the cart's rotation)

parameters.name: b_joint1
parameters.description: Viscous friction of joint 1 (bearing grease)

parameters.name: b_joint2
parameters.description: Viscous friction of joint 2

parameters.name: b_cable
parameters.description: Damping (drag) of that cable loop across joint 1

parameters.name: b_carriage
parameters.description: Viscous friction of the carriage on its linear guide and of the belt

parameters.name: b_cable_base
parameters.description: Drag of the cable chain along the rail

parameters.name: b_motor
parameters.description: Viscous loss of the motor bearings (x (N/r)^2 = 0.070 N s/m at the cart)

parameters.name: R_m
parameters.description: Armature resistance with the leads and the drive's on-resistance (hot winding up to +20 %)

parameters.name: L_m
parameters.description: Armature inductance; with R_m the current lag of the voltage-mode drive, tau = L_m / R_m (0.33 ms nominal: the twin's current loop)

parameters.name: k_t
parameters.description: Torque constant = back-EMF constant k_e (V s/rad), +-5 %

parameters.name: J_m
parameters.description: Rotor inertia with the gearbox input stage, at the motor shaft (x (N/r)^2 = 0.49 kg at the cart)

parameters.name: N_gear
parameters.description: Gear ratio, motor turns per pulley turn (exact)

parameters.name: r_pulley
parameters.description: Effective (pitch) radius of the belt pulley

parameters.name: k_belt
parameters.description: Belt stiffness between pulley and cart (bond graph and FMU; the twin is belt-rigid, the screen checks the belt mode on the linearisation)

parameters.name: d_belt
parameters.description: Belt damping (bond graph and FMU)

parameters.name: x_rail
parameters.description: Free travel of the cart centre to the soft end stops, +-x_rail

parameters.name: k_stop
parameters.description: Stiffness of the rubber end stops (bond graph; the twin counts a run that reaches x_rail as failed)

parameters.name: d_stop
parameters.description: Damping of the end stops

parameters.name: tc_joint1
parameters.description: Coulomb (breakaway) friction of joint 1, a pair of shielded 688 ball bearings; smooth form tc tanh(w / eps_joint). The screen (screen_results.json) gives the budget

parameters.name: tc_joint2
parameters.description: Coulomb (breakaway) friction of joint 2, a pair of shielded 688 ball bearings; smooth form tc tanh(w / eps_joint)

parameters.name: eps_joint
parameters.description: Velocity scale of the smooth Coulomb law (numerical, fixed)

parameters.name: tc_carriage
parameters.description: Coulomb friction of the carriage on its linear guide, the belt and the cable chain

parameters.name: tc_motor
parameters.description: Coulomb friction at the motor shaft: brushes, bearings, gearbox (x N/r = 0.375 N at the cart)

parameters.name: eps_base
parameters.description: Velocity scale of the smooth Coulomb law on the cart (numerical, fixed)

parameters.name: k_cable
parameters.description: Bending stiffness of the joint-2 encoder cable loop across joint 1 (joint 2 has no cable across it); neutral at the upright

parameters.name: k_cable_base
parameters.description: Spring of the cable chain along the rail, neutral at the rail centre

parameters.name: ripple_rel
parameters.description: Commutation torque ripple, relative to the motor force

parameters.name: ripple_per_rev
parameters.description: Ripple periods per motor revolution (7 commutator segments x 2)

parameters.name: cogging
parameters.description: Cogging force at the cart (motor cogging torque x N / r)

parameters.name: cogging_per_rev
parameters.description: Cogging periods per motor revolution (7 slots, 2 poles)

parameters.name: m1
parameters.description: link 1 mass (lumped parts)

parameters.name: c1
parameters.description: joint 1 to the centre of mass of link 1

parameters.name: J1
parameters.value: m_tube1*(L1*L1/12 + ((tube_od/2)*(tube_od/2) + (tube_od/2 - tube_wall)*(tube_od/2 - tube_wall))/4) + m_tube1*(L1*(0.5 + com_shift1) - c1)*(L1*(0.5 + com_shift1) - c1) + m_hub1*s_hub*s_hub/6 + m_hub1*(0.0 - c1)*(0.0 - c1) + 0.0 + m_enc_magnet*(0.0 - c1)*(0.0 - c1) + m_head1*s_head*s_head/6 + m_head1*(L1 - c1)*(L1 - c1) + 0.0 + m_enc_board*(L1 - c1)*(L1 - c1) + rho_cable*L1*L1*L1/12 + (rho_cable*L1)*((L1/2) - c1)*((L1/2) - c1)
parameters.description: link 1 inertia about its centre of mass (parallel axes)

parameters.name: m2
parameters.description: link 2 mass (lumped parts)

parameters.name: c2
parameters.description: joint 2 to the centre of mass of link 2

parameters.name: J2
parameters.value: m_tube2*(L2*L2/12 + ((tube_od/2)*(tube_od/2) + (tube_od/2 - tube_wall)*(tube_od/2 - tube_wall))/4) + m_tube2*(L2*(0.5 + com_shift2) - c2)*(L2*(0.5 + com_shift2) - c2) + m_hub2*s_hub*s_hub/6 + m_hub2*(0.0 - c2)*(0.0 - c2) + 0.0 + m_enc_magnet*(0.0 - c2)*(0.0 - c2) + m_tip2*s_tip*s_tip/6 + m_tip2*(L2 - c2)*(L2 - c2)
parameters.description: link 2 inertia about its centre of mass (parallel axes)

parameters.name: rx2
parameters.description: joint 2 in the frame of link 1's centre of mass

parameters.name: lever2
parameters.description: lever of the tip push about link 2's centre of mass

parameters.name: b1
parameters.description: joint 1 viscous friction with the cable drag

parameters.name: b_rail
parameters.description: carriage, belt and cable-chain viscous friction

parameters.name: d1
parameters.description: static pivot deflection of joint 1 (hanging)

parameters.name: d2
parameters.description: static pivot deflection of joint 2 (hanging)

parameters.name: d_rail
parameters.description: static rail deflection

parameters.name: n_motor
parameters.description: motor angle per cart metre

parameters.name: alpha_v
parameters.description: force per volt at the cart (the twin's alpha)

parameters.name: tc_rail
parameters.description: carriage + motor Coulomb friction at the cart

parameters.name: loop_delay
parameters.description: Whole-sample delay from sampling to the applied voltage: sample, compute, PWM update (integer)

parameters.name: joint_noise
parameters.description: White angle noise of a joint encoder before quantisation (assumed for an AS5048-class sensor; check the datasheet of the part used)

options.text: **R1 policy** (domain randomisation) on the realistic plant: realism forces, encoder noise, 2 ms delay. Nominal scenario. Expect upright at 3.97 s, about 1° of jitter, 10.8° after the push, voltage chatter.
